description: We are two enthusiastic engineering students from the Faculty of Robotics and Instrumentation Engineering (FRIE) at Igor Sikorsky Kyiv Polytechnic Institute. As first-time participants in this hackathon, we are diving in headfirst to gain hands-on practical experience, push our limits, and turn innovative engineering ideas into working prototypes.
summary: AstroPulse: Crew Health Twin is an autonomous onboard health-monitoring console designed for astronauts on long-duration lunar and Martian missions. Deep-space crews face five major NASA Human Research Program (HRP) hazards—radiation, altered gravity, isolation, closed environments, and up to 44-minute round-trip communication delays—making real-time telemedicine impossible. AstroPulse integrates 8 biometric and dosimeter inputs, an interactive anatomical body map, a 5-second Psychomotor Vigilance Task (PVT) cognitive reflex test, and mathematical modeling of bone mineral density loss and radiation-induced immune risks. When anomalies occur, the system immediately provides step-by-step self-care countermeasures, tracks daily EVA readiness habits, and exports structured JSON telemetry packets for Flight Surgeons.
details:
What It Does & How It Works: AstroPulse: Crew Health Twin is an offline-first autonomous bio-telemetry and countermeasure console designed for deep-space crews. It continuously evaluates four physiological systems across four mission profiles (ISS Orbital Station, Lunar Artemis Base, Mars Transit Vehicle, and Martian Rover EVA):

  • CNS & Behavioral Health: Tracks sleep duration and runs an interactive 3-trial NASA Psychomotor Vigilance Task (PVT) reaction-time test to objectively score neurocognitive fatigue.
  • Cardiovascular System: Monitors resting Heart Rate (BPM) and Blood Pressure (mmHg) with 7-day trend charts to detect orthostatic intolerance, arrhythmia, or tachycardia.
  • Musculoskeletal & Bone Density: Models cumulative bone mineral density loss (%) based on mission duration (Sol), local gravity field (0g to 0.38g), and daily ARED resistive exercise adherence.
  • Immune, Metabolic & Radiation: Combines personal radiation dosimeter logs (mSv), core body temperature (°C), and blood glucose (mg/dL) to flag immune suppression or metabolic emergencies.

Benefits & Intended Impact: Deep-space missions face communication delays of up to 44 minutes round-trip with Earth, making real-time telemedicine impossible. AstroPulse empowers astronauts to self-diagnose early physiological deviations and immediately execute step-by-step self-care protocols without waiting for Mission Control.

Creativity & Factors Considered: Our team (Project POpiros) integrated NASA Human Research Program (HRP) 5 Hazards directly into the diagnostic engine—combining an interactive color-coded SVG body map, a live bio-suit telemetry stream, a real-time round-trip communication latency simulator, gamified daily EVA readiness tracking, and one-click JSON medical packet export for Flight Surgeons.

Tools, Coding Languages & Software Used: HTML5, Tailwind CSS, Vanilla JavaScript, Chart.js, custom SVG graphics, GitHub, and GitHub Pages.
